property_summary: For any caller who successfully calls lockInGuess sending exactly 1 ether, the contract sets a nonzero future block number for that caller (guesses[msg.sender].block != 0); the mutant that omits that assignment leaves it zero and thus violates this invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to guesses[msg.sender].block entirely (delete that statement), leaving the block value unchanged (zero) after lockInGuess.
